summary: John's 2nd great-uncle; eldest brother of great-grandfather William F. Meier.
bio: Born 15 Sep 1892 in Hazleton; laborer in a moulding shop aged 17 (1910). Speculative candidate for the 'Frederick Meier of Wilkes-Barre' whose wife Anna died 9 Feb 1940 aged 47 — which could be the source of the tree's '1940' for Henry.
openQuestions: Was his wife the Anna Meier (Mrs. Frederick) who died 9 Feb 1940 in Wilkes-Barre, aged 47?
